as_told.title: Aldrin's fighter pilot sighting over Japan, per his sister

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker who investigates UFO stories, says Fay Ann Potter, the sister of the astronaut Buzz Aldrin, told him her brother once had a UFO encounter while flying a military jet, sometime in the 1950s or 1960s. When podcast host Jesse Michels retells it, he places the encounter over Japan, when Aldrin was a fighter pilot, and says the sister spoke of two sightings. If true, one of the first men on the Moon would himself have seen something unexplained.
